intent: Plan A: Dashboard UI harness foundation (Playwright + isolated fleet + Ready protocol + debug seam)
notes: Plan A of the Dashboard UX v2.13.0 track — ships the Playwright + pytest harness that Plans B (safe-content-transport) and C (responsive-shell-and-sidebar) depend on. Nothing user-visible: additive dashboard-side changes only, plus a new source-CI lane and a new test directory.

`main()` — `--port 0` binds directly to a kernel-assigned port (skipping `find_free_port` which returns its input on 0, not the assigned port); `actual_port = server.server_address[1]` reads the real port back. Ready protocol: prints `Ready on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` at column 0 (no leading whitespace, `127.0.0.1` literal, trailing slash) AFTER bind and BEFORE `serve_forever`, with `flush=True`. This exact line is a public interface for the dashboard-ui test harness and any external tooling that boots the dashboard.

When `args.repo` is set, prints an indented `  Open: {open_url}` line AFTER the Ready line — preserves the pre-Plan-A behavior of `--no-open --repo NAME` surfacing the repo-scoped URL, without disturbing the machine-readable Ready protocol.

New `DashboardHandler._send_dashboard_html()` peer of `_send_file` that reads `dashboard.html`, conditionally injects `<meta name="gator-debug" content="1">` when `GATOR_DASHBOARD_DEBUG=1`, and sends body + UTF-8 headers. Root-route branch in `do_GET()` switched from `_send_file` to `_send_dashboard_html()`. Env-var check is PER-REQUEST (not startup-cached) so the harness can select the seam per-child at spawn time.

New `/api/__gator_debug/registry_state` endpoint gated on `GATOR_DASHBOARD_DEBUG=1` — returns the live `_REGISTRY_REPOS` global (the actual state every handler operates on, not a recomputed `Path.home()` shortcut). Returns 404 when the env var is unset; the endpoint does not exist in production.

New `window.__gator_debug` seam inside the same IIFE as `_treeState`. Meta-tag gated (block is a no-op when the tag is absent). Top-level object frozen (no setters, no adding methods); getter builds a fresh plain-object snapshot per call — snapshots intentionally NOT frozen so tests can spoof-mutate them to prove they aren't live references.
